value.rationale: A sharp true-duration sign criterion in the natural two-component mixed-tide proxy is structurally different from its easy-to-compute cubic-rate skewness. Proving no amplitude-induced reversal in the entire two-high-water domain and identifying a critical duration boundary supplies a mathematically motivated benchmark against the documented unreliability of skewness as a general duration proxy, without claiming empirical forecasts.
